binning_rule: equal-width ECE with n_bins bins over [0, 1]: bin index for confidence c is min(int(c * n_bins), n_bins - 1), so bin i covers [i/n_bins, (i+1)/n_bins) except the last bin which includes c == 1.0; ECE = sum_b (|B_b| / N) * |acc(B_b) - conf(B_b)| where acc is the fraction of correct items and conf the mean confidence in bin b; empty bins contribute 0.

answer_relevance.shortfall: insufficient human-checked rows for 'answer_relevance': n_labels=0 < 60 required; gate stays closed (no padding, no imputation).
